observed_facts.fact: Real controlled order is exact paused state -> peer -> guard publication/local topic receipt -> all3 target storage receipts -> 20 real physics ticks -> exact clock -> next boundary commit/evaluator phase.
Nonzero tracker.output clears anchor/active before actual Twist and tagged-target publish.
Native status acknowledges immutable target storage, not wheel application or body response.
WORLD odom is published before actuator selection/write in the same WorldUpdateBegin; actuation journal binds the consumed target sequence and actual measured/desired/applied wheel rim values.
50Hz guard / 30Hz actuator means a stored target can be superseded before any actuation. Never require every original publication seq to be applied.
Old settled reader closes its grant interval at first nonzero storage or final physics and checks cumulative raw chords, not continuous-body handoff after storage.
Tracker future-source comment does not defer active model updates: observe updates/fails active speed/path immediately, whereas local_state and normal_velocity_fault select only causal sources.
Current near-peer directional gate uses forward scalar signs and ignores magnitude<=1e-4; raw WORLD odometry retains lateral body-y. Norm bounds do not prove no-side-slip.
Original target parser demands exactly7 fields; current storage status client also has an exact field set. No mode/anchor fields can be silently inserted.
Stop channel is permanent and acknowledges only zero publication/storage stages; normal receipt failure is not repaired by a later stop ACK.
Common-frame position uses the current received map->odom transform; raw anchor and common-frame geometry cannot be mixed without a fixed lift or bounded transform error.

prospective_constant_intent.numeric_note: These are decimal contract intentions, not a claim of exact binary64 arithmetic or a completed new proof; prototype must conservatively enclose arithmetic and preserve original source definitions.

coverage_obligations.statement: Generic transition reach starts from all states in old D(a,R), not singleton current observed pose or zero velocity; cover residual old commands, arbitrary allowed storage/actuation ordering, candidate/successors, body response and full backup.

At every allowed future time, every actual body center is in its pre-authorized coverage set; all pair combinations remain separated by original body disks/geometric margin and properly accounted source/frame uncertainty.
Old source point and future center may differ by2R for one fixed disk. R=.0078 gives2R=.0156; this is a mathematical candidate accounting consequence, not an implemented threshold or new native PASS.
No lateral component may be discarded. A finite full-planar stopping radius needs a full-planar body braking/side-slip assumption or proof, beyond wheel-rim slew and speed norm.
Pending coverage must already be sound before publication. Old zero-only premise is not claimed after it may cease; old anchor persists as evidence/debt while bridge owns overlap.
Separate qualification clock reset from protection retirement. Any nonzero magnitude can invalidate a zero-publication qualification timer, but cannot itself delete or renew active anchor.
Treat staged future raw separately from causal safety updates; drain all causal records by source/ingress order, retain conflicts/gaps and reject silent bounded-history eviction.
Cover last raw source through current pause, next real quantum and stop/backup. Freshness or chords alone do not prove intersample containment.
Keep old readers/schema/math immutable and version the prospective model, sidecar and independently reconstructed interval semantics.

tiny_nonzero_rule: No epsilon-based clear/reanchor. Any publication may break qualification history, but only a real complete generic coverage handoff plus subsequent full new qualification can admit a fresh anchor; a superseded never-applied pulse cannot do so.

evidence_binding_plan.mode_sidecar: Draft concept only; bind epoch/robot/clock/decision_sequence/v/w, actual target bytes/hash and real state-peer/motion receipts. No existing schema modified.
evidence_binding_plan.actuation_evidence: Existing flushed native actuation journal includes consumed target seq and wheel feedback; a trustworthy online own-driver journal tail or future read-only feed is still an explicit unresolved implementation decision.
evidence_binding_plan.raw_source_rule: All safety updates are causal; source<=actual committed clock/physical watermark. Future samples are held immutable, never used as current evidence or silently discarded.
evidence_binding_plan.same_stamp_rule: WORLD odom precedes current tick actuation; require strict later raw source or separate native phase-order proof.
evidence_binding_plan.last_source_rule: 100ms freshness is necessary, not a continuous-tail proof.
evidence_binding_plan.information_boundary: Own driver/odom only for each local owner; peers remain received-only. Do not improve pair availability by adding cross-robot raw/mode shortcuts.

availability_design: Full2D isotropic generic+backup may admit far translations conditionally on fullplanar stopping bound. Near directional availability requires robust2D velocity/heading/side-slip evolution, not only sign(v_x). Preserve original Nav2 requests or declared component filtering; never invent exploration or steering fallback.
planned_cpu_counterexamples_not_executed: Nonzero published with no exact native storage ACK: no anchor clearing and no physical permission.
Stored seqA superseded by seqB/stop before any actuation: no per-seq-actuation deadlock or fictitious handoff.
Normal/stop same-clock interleaving: permanent stop cannot become successful normal.
Subnormal/tiny alternating nonzero v and repeated zero/grants cannot mint new anchors.
Outward velocity at disk boundary despite three rest samples: no inferred continuous invariance.
v_x0 plus nonzero v_y toward peer, or later side-slip: scalar-sign permissiveness rejected without full2D certificate.
Future raw arrives before clock; process only once causal, retaining its eventual violation.
Same source same/different bytes, regressions, source gap and history overflow preserve identity or fail explicitly.
Same-stamp pre-actuation odom cannot certify post-actuation body response.
Between-sample/last-sample-to-end disk excursion defeats chord-only or freshness-only evidence.
TF jump/frame rotation and reverse translation do not move anchor or erase lateral uncertainty.
Generic initialization from whole disk vs singleton, and R vs2R under source-based geometry.
Demonstrate genuine allowed far/near translations plus expected rejects; permanent all-zero output is not availability proof.

Full2D generic reach and backup, including lateral drift, wheel->body tracking/coupling, angular changes and stopping terminal set.
Common-frame lift/TF error/localization change is bounded and compatible with fixed raw anchor and peer received-state geometry.
Actual actuation records can be causally and trustworthily bound to worker/guard online. Current storage ACK alone cannot supply them.
Sample-to-boundary/next quantum/backup continuous tails and same-timestamp native phase ordering are covered.
All pair mode combinations and compositional induction preserve original body/contact/source/task gates with no remote raw-state shortcut.
Legal translation witnesses and absence of20ms/30Hz supersession deadlock without a blanket zero-only workaround.
New independent prospective reader reconstructs anchor, qualification, successor target chain, storage/application/body endpoints and source causality from immutable original evidence.
